questions.question: What does Psalm 52 confront?
options: A boastful, deceitful man trusting in his riches
A faithful priest serving God in the holy temple
A humble servant patiently waiting on the LORD
A wise king ruling over the nations with justice
questions.answer: A boastful, deceitful man trusting in his riches

questions.question: To what does David compare himself in contrast?
options: A palm tree standing tall in the courts
A fruitful vine spreading over the wall
A mighty cedar on the heights of Lebanon
A green olive tree in the house of God
questions.answer: A green olive tree in the house of God
